The '''Walking Garden''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It had [[lycandis]] and [[blartree blossom]]s among its many displayed flora.<ref name="apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
